text:
Maya: Quick async check — we need to lock down owners and short ETAs for the v2 compatibility rollout checklist. Reply with the item you own + ETA. Items: 1) public docs migration checklist, 2) SDK (py/ts) semver bump + changelog, 3) compat smoke tests for streaming & streaming-edge cases, 4) rollback/fallback policy (model mapping + circuit breakers). Call out blockers. cc: @Jon @Liam @Priya @Sara

Jon: I can own (3) — streaming compat smoke tests. ETA: end of week (Fri). Need: a small list of P0 prompts and access to the canary cluster. Also want a test harness for partial responses. :white_check_mark:

Priya: I'll take (1) and (4) (docs checklist + rollback policy). Target: draft by Wed EOD. Blocker: legal wants explicit deprecation language for EU customers — cc @Sam Legal.

Liam: SDK lead here — we'll target a Python release (0.9.0) + TS patch next Thu. Will open PRs to bump semver and add migration notes/examples. If API surface changes land late we will feature-flag the breaking changes. PR: github.com/rw/sdk/pull/2345 (draft). Need final API spec or stable branch for tests.

Chris: I'll review the SDK PR — will try to get to it tomorrow morning. FYI there's a breaking change to `Client.chat` signature so please add a clear migration snippet.

deploy-bot: Canary snapshot created: canary-20240316-12. URL: https://canary.internal.rw/deploys/canary-20240316-12 - access granted to group `v2-smoketesters`.

Sara: I gave `v2-smoketesters` access and enabled request tracing for that cluster. @Jon you should be able to use the header `x-rw-trace` to correlate traces.

Jon: Perfect — thanks @Sara. Quick smoke run command for the harness:```bash
# stream smoke run
python smoke.py --endpoint https://canary.internal.rw/api/v2/stream --token $TOKEN --trace-header x-rw-trace
```

Priya: Legal (Sam) — any immediate edits to the deprecation wording we should prep before docs go live?

Sam Legal: I can review the draft by Tue. Two asks: (a) include export controls blurb for older models, (b) give customers 60 days notice with a migration guide link. We can reuse last EOL template if you attach it.

Maya: Good. I'll drop the previous EOL template into the rollout doc and tag you when it's ready. One more ask: please note any infra/dependency bumps (e.g., proto changes) that need cross-team coordination.

Liam: SDK depends on updated openapi spec + minor proto bump (v1.2 -> v1.3). That requires eng-platform to publish stable spec branch. Marking blocker unless spec branch available by Wed.

Priya: Eng-platform, can we get a pinned spec branch by Wed? @team-eng-platform

Maya: If you can't meet that timeline, call it out by EOD — we may shift SDK release or feature-flag. Thanks all — I will consolidate owners/ETAs in the rollout doc: https://internal.rw/rollouts/v2-compat (will update as replies come in).
